environment: Native Three geometry and CPU Canvas with simulated DOM/clock; browser checks are separate.

checks.name: script starts with a silent blue-sky shot and follows sky, boat, approach, dock and welcome
all four chosen heroes are real 3D rigs on a boat, with islanders, pier and independently disposable scenery
blue sky automatically leads to the first monologue, which waits for the reader
text reveal is immediate and does not accidentally skip the current line
travel animation gates progress and completion runs exactly once after every dialogue
the game bridge freezes saves and clocks, then completes introduction before difficulty selection
replaying the story leaves existing progress, money, energy and save count untouched
title start and resume retain all four hero IDs and load cinematic before the title script
